name: robotactions
title: RobotActions Agent Skills
description: Agent Skills that teach an AI coding agent how to drive real Android and iOS devices and browsers through the RobotActions MCP server.

skills.name: robotactions-getting-started
skills.title: Getting started
skills.description: Connect an MCP host to the RobotActions device cloud and verify the connection works. Use when RobotActions tools are missing or erroring, when setting up a new machine or CI job, when a call returns 401/403, or when the user asks how to install, configure, or authenticate the RobotActions MCP server.

skills.name: mobile-app-testing
skills.title: Mobile app testing
skills.description: Drive real Android and iOS devices to test native mobile apps — install an app, navigate its UI, assert on what is on screen, and capture evidence. Use when asked to test, explore, reproduce a bug in, or automate a mobile app on a real phone or tablet.

skills.name: web-app-testing
skills.title: Web app testing
skills.description: Test websites and web apps in the browser of a real Android or iOS device, or in a desktop browser on the grid. Use for mobile web testing, responsive checks on real hardware, page network and console debugging, and request mocking.

skills.name: device-state-setup
skills.title: Device state setup
skills.description: Put a real device into the state a test needs — push files so an upload or file-picker flow has something to pick, seed an app's own container with fixtures, mock GPS location, force a locale, and reset to a clean first-run state.

skills.name: network-mocking
skills.title: Network mocking & capture
skills.description: Capture and mock network traffic on real devices, for native app requests as well as web pages. Use for error states, empty states, offline paths and slow-network testing without a broken backend.

skills.name: framework-integration
skills.title: Framework integration
skills.description: Use the MCP tools alongside an existing Appium, Selenium, Playwright or WebdriverIO suite rather than replacing it — lift stable locators into page objects, emit tests in the user's own framework, and run that suite against the grid.

skills.name: flow-record-replay
skills.title: Flow record & replay
skills.description: Turn a manual walkthrough of a mobile app into a saved, replayable regression test — record steps with assertions, build reusable components, replay on any device, and diagnose failures step by step.
